hunks.baseline: “Y-you? What are you doing there?”
hunks.sol: “Y-you? What are you doing here?”

hunks.baseline: “What do you mean, ‘could it be’? It is.”
hunks.sol: “No ‘could it be’ about it. It is.”

hunks.baseline: Kim Sangshik’s face went dark and sallow, like a man with shit poisoning.
hunks.sol: Kim Sangshik’s face turned dark and sallow, like he’d been poisoned by shit.

hunks.baseline: Seeing him like that felt like ten years of constipation finally letting go. Ah. So this was a shitgasm.
hunks.sol: Seeing him like that felt like ten years of constipation finally letting go. Ah, so this was a shitgasm.

hunks.baseline: “Anyway, let’s take a step back. We’re not the only ones here, you know.”
hunks.sol: “Anyway, back up a little. You’re not the only one here, you know.”

hunks.baseline: I took a step forward, and Kim Sangshik backed away weakly.
hunks.sol: I took a step forward, and Kim Sangshik retreated weakly.

hunks.baseline: “Sangdong Guild. We promise the best possible treatment.”
hunks.sol: “Sangdong Guild. We promise you the best possible treatment.”

hunks.baseline: “Instead of doing this here, why don’t we move somewhere private and talk…”
hunks.sol: “Why don’t we move somewhere private and discuss this…?”

hunks.baseline: Recruitment offers poured in from every direction. In no time at all, dozens of business cards were in my hands.
hunks.sol: Recruitment offers poured in from every direction. In no time at all, I had dozens of business cards in my hands.

hunks.baseline: It was a novel, peculiar feeling. Things I hadn’t experienced even once in seven years were unfolding right in front of me.
hunks.sol: It was a strange new feeling. Things I hadn’t experienced even once in seven years were unfolding right before my eyes.

hunks.baseline: People said that in this business, C-rank was where you started being a real Hunter. Exceptional ability, a high salary, and society’s recognition as a mid-level Hunter.
hunks.sol: People said that in this business, C-rank was where you started being a real Hunter. Exceptional ability, a high salary, and recognition from society as a mid-level Hunter.

hunks.baseline: That was how I would step onto a new path faster than any other Hunter.
hunks.sol: I would set out down a new path faster than any other Hunter.

hunks.baseline: “Sir, if you have any conditions you want, we’ll meet them no matter what.”
hunks.sol: “Sir, name your terms and we’ll meet them, no matter what.”

hunks.baseline: “Ah, yes. I’ll get in touch later.”
hunks.sol: “Ah, sure. I’ll get in touch later.”

hunks.baseline: Association security guards stepped in and blocked the scouts who kept clinging to me.
hunks.sol: Association security guards stepped in and held back the scouts who kept crowding around me.

hunks.baseline: They didn’t usually go that far for a C-rank Hunter. I was just such a rare case that I seemed to be drawing a lot of attention.
hunks.sol: They didn’t usually go this far over a C-rank Hunter, but I was such a rare case that I seemed to be drawing a lot of attention.

hunks.baseline: *Well, I did jump that far from a single reawakening.*
hunks.sol: *Well, I did make quite a jump with a single reawakening.*

hunks.baseline: I fought down a smile that kept trying to break out and left the Association. Even then, one person still followed me.
hunks.sol: I fought down the smile that kept tugging at my lips and left the Association. Even then, one person followed me.

hunks.baseline: “Heh.”
hunks.sol: “Hah.”

hunks.baseline: I looked at Kim Sangshik and swallowed a hollow laugh.
hunks.sol: I looked at Kim Sangshik and swallowed a disbelieving laugh.

hunks.baseline: Kim Sangshik rambled, spilling out every wrong he’d done to me in the past. When that untimely confession was over, he finally got to the point.
hunks.sol: Kim Sangshik rambled on, spilling out every wrong he’d done me in the past. Once his untimely confession was over, he finally got to the point.

hunks.baseline: “So let’s forget all of it and treat this as business.”
hunks.sol: “So let’s forget all that and treat this as business.”

hunks.baseline: It sounded good. The feeling was terrible. Even more so because the business partner was Kim Sangshik and Sopung Guild.
hunks.sol: It had a nice ring to it. The feeling it gave me was terrible. Even more so when the business partner was Kim Sangshik and Sopung Guild.

hunks.baseline: “I’m telling you to think it through. They won’t be hurting for you. That’s the kind of place where a C-rank Hunter isn’t hard to find. The treatment will be exactly that level, too.”
hunks.sol: “I’m telling you to think it through. They won’t be desperate to have you. That’s the kind of place where a C-rank Hunter isn’t hard to find. They’ll treat you like any other C-rank, too.”

hunks.baseline: “No matter what they offer, we’ll add more on top. The Guild Master already signed off on that, so you can count on it.”
hunks.sol: “No matter what anyone else offers, we’ll add more on top. The Guild Master has already signed off on it, so you can count on that.”

hunks.baseline: Given the situation, the Guild Master seemed scared shitless.
hunks.sol: Given the situation, the Guild Master must have been scared shitless.

hunks.baseline: *This guy’s no different.*
hunks.sol: *And this guy’s no different.*

hunks.baseline: The Guild’s opinion of him was already at rock bottom, and now the F-rank Hunter he’d fired on a whim a few days ago had reawakened as C-rank.
hunks.sol: His standing in the Guild was already at rock bottom, and now the F-rank Hunter he’d fired on a whim a few days ago had reawakened as a C-rank.

hunks.baseline: I found myself smiling at the thought of what would happen when the Guild Master, notorious for his temper, found out.
hunks.sol: The corners of my mouth rose at the thought of what would happen when the Guild Master, notorious for his temper, found out.

hunks.baseline: “Just look at it positively. Actually, forget standing around here. Why don’t we go somewhere decent and talk it out honestly? The Guild Master is on his way here right—”
hunks.sol: “Just think about it favorably. Actually, forget standing around here. Why don’t we go somewhere decent and talk openly? The Guild Master is already on his way—”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll think about it if he gets rid of one man I can’t stand the sight of.”
hunks.sol: “There’s one man I can’t stand the sight of. Tell him I’ll think about it if he gets rid of that man.”

hunks.baseline: Leaving Kim Sangshik behind with his face twisted in fury, I got into a taxi.
hunks.sol: Leaving Kim Sangshik behind with his face twisted, I got into a taxi.

hunks.baseline: The rank reassessment. Running into old bad blood. An indescribable rush, and at the same time a sense of relief.
hunks.sol: The rank reassessment. Running into an old enemy. I felt an indescribable rush and, at the same time, a deep sense of relief.

hunks.baseline: We laid out a mat and a grill on the goshiwon roof. Jinho hyung gazed happily at the meat as it cooked.
hunks.sol: We spread out a mat and set up a grill on the goshiwon roof. Jinho hyung gazed happily at the meat as it cooked.

hunks.baseline: “All right. Seeing your sincerity, I’ll forget about the finder’s fee.”
hunks.sol: “All right. In recognition of this heartfelt gesture, I’ll forget about the finder’s fee.”

hunks.baseline: We sat across from each other and tilted our soju glasses.
hunks.sol: We sat across from each other and knocked back our soju.

hunks.baseline: “How much could that be? Did you give up on life after getting fired from the Guild?”
hunks.sol: “How much could that possibly be? Did you give up on life after getting fired from the Guild?”

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t help letting out a little laugh.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t help letting out a short laugh.

hunks.baseline: “I should laugh. You’re treating ten million won like pocket change.”
hunks.sol: “Of course I am. You’re treating ten million won like pocket change.”

hunks.baseline: “You made ten million won in one day’s pay?”
hunks.sol: “You made ten million won in a single day?”

hunks.baseline: “A little more came in, but that’s for now.”
hunks.sol: “A little more, actually, but call it ten million for now.”

hunks.baseline: If you only heard that, you’d think he was the prime minister, not a goshiwon manager.[^2]
hunks.sol: The way he said it, you’d think he was the prime minister, not the manager of a goshiwon.

hunks.baseline: “Bring me proof. I only believe what I see with my own eyes.”
hunks.sol: “Show me proof. I only believe what I see with my own eyes.”

hunks.baseline: I handed him my phone. It was the message I’d gotten on the way back from the Association after the reassessment.
hunks.sol: I handed him my phone. It showed the message I’d received on my way back from the Association after the reassessment.

hunks.baseline: “Luxury Nutjob? Who’s that?”
hunks.sol: “Designer-Brand Freak? Who’s this?”

hunks.baseline: A moment later, Jinho hyung finished the message and his eyes went wide.
hunks.sol: A moment later, Jinho hyung finished reading the message and his eyes went wide.

hunks.baseline: When I came to, I found myself in a nearby supermarket, grabbing every piece of beef I could get my hands on.
hunks.sol: When I came to my senses, I found myself in a nearby supermarket, grabbing every piece of beef I could get my hands on.

hunks.baseline: Jinho hyung stared blankly, looking from me to the phone in my hand.
hunks.sol: Jinho hyung stared blankly, looking back and forth between me and the phone in his hand.

hunks.baseline: “And your lifespan is short?”
hunks.sol: “And your life’s a short one?”

hunks.baseline: I figured it was better if, for Jinho hyung, it just stayed an absurd lie.
hunks.sol: I figured it was better if, to Jinho hyung, it remained nothing more than an absurd lie.

hunks.baseline: At a life-or-death moment, the luck of a reawakening had come, and I’d been able to take them down. Then I told him about the Association.
hunks.sol: I told him that I’d reawakened at the moment my life was in danger, giving me the power to take them down. Then I told him what had happened at the Association.

hunks.baseline: “The reassessment procedure will take a few days, so technically, not yet.”
hunks.sol: “The reassessment process will take a few days, so technically, not yet.”

hunks.baseline: Jinho hyung stared at me for a long moment. Moisture gathered in his eyes.
hunks.sol: Jinho hyung stared at me for a long moment. Tears welled in his eyes.

hunks.baseline: “…Don’t tell me you’re crying?”
hunks.sol: “…Don’t tell me you’re crying.”

hunks.baseline: He turned away with an unnecessary curse, but he couldn’t hide the single tear that slipped down. I watched him out of the corner of my eye as he roughly rubbed his face with his sleeve.
hunks.sol: He turned away with an unnecessary curse, but he couldn’t hide the single tear that fell. I watched him out of the corner of my eye as he roughly scrubbed his face with his sleeve.

hunks.baseline: As I turned the meat, I felt flustered, and yet a corner of my chest tickled.
hunks.sol: As I turned the meat, I felt flustered, yet there was a strange tickle in my chest.

hunks.baseline: Sometimes I wondered if this was what it would have felt like to have a real older brother. We had lived like brothers, like friends.
hunks.sol: Sometimes I wondered if this was what it would have felt like to have a real older brother. We’d lived like brothers, like friends.

hunks.baseline: “Good for you.”
hunks.sol: “I’m glad things worked out.”

hunks.baseline: At just those words, something surged up from deep inside me. The emotions and memories that had stacked up over the past seven years all came rushing in at once.
hunks.sol: At those few words, something surged up from deep inside me. All the emotions and memories that had piled up over the past seven years came rushing in at once.

hunks.baseline: We hugged each other tightly across the grill. Jinho hyung whispered in my ear, his voice shaking.
hunks.sol: We embraced tightly across the grill. Jinho hyung whispered in my ear, his voice shaking.

hunks.baseline: “You have to pay the finder’s fee. Hyung’s having a hard time these days.”
hunks.sol: “You have to pay me the finder’s fee. Hyung’s having a hard time these days.”

hunks.baseline: I let out a little laugh, thinking of the one person who was probably cleaning up the roof while grumbling.
hunks.sol: A short laugh escaped me as I thought of the one person who was probably cleaning up the roof while grumbling.

hunks.baseline: That was Jinho hyung. The way he congratulated me, and that last prank.
hunks.sol: That was Jinho hyung. The way he congratulated me, and the joke at the end.

hunks.baseline: I knew all of it was just his way of showing it.
hunks.sol: I knew it was all just his way of expressing himself.

hunks.baseline: Those words kept circling in my head. It was embarrassing to admit, but for a moment there, I had almost cried.
hunks.sol: Those words kept circling in my head. It was embarrassing to admit, but at that moment, I’d almost cried.

hunks.baseline: After my father died, I had run nonstop. I graduated high school while working part-time jobs, and I had to hold on and keep holding on for my sick mother and little sister.
hunks.sol: After my father died, I’d run nonstop. I graduated high school while working part-time jobs, and I had to keep going, no matter what, for my sick mother and little sister.

hunks.baseline: At some point, all of it had become a given.
hunks.sol: At some point, all of it had simply become a given.

hunks.baseline: And then.
hunks.sol: And then—

hunks.baseline:
> **System**
>
> - You have been afflicted with a Status Effect: Dead Drunk.
> - It can be detoxified by circulating your qi.
hunks.sol:
> **System**
>
> - You have been afflicted with the Status Effect: Dead Drunk.
> - It can be detoxified by circulating your qi.

hunks.baseline: It had all started with that unidentified junk game capsule.
hunks.sol: It had all started with that mysterious piece-of-junk game capsule.

hunks.baseline: That was the world I knew. Everything had a price tag. Visible or not, sooner or later you had to pay.
hunks.sol: That was the world I knew. Everything had a price tag. Whether you could see it or not, sooner or later, you had to pay.

hunks.baseline: I laughed weakly and felt my eyelids growing heavy.
hunks.sol: I laughed weakly as my eyelids grew heavy.

hunks.baseline: Outside the window, the grass insects were crying loudly. My vision darkened, and sleep poured over me.
hunks.sol: Insects chirped loudly outside the window. My vision darkened, and sleep poured over me.

hunks.baseline: “Squad leader, squad leader!”
hunks.sol: “Squad Leader! Squad Leader!”

hunks.baseline: Weirdly, just hearing it made me want to punch whoever it belonged to. Part of me wanted to see who that familiar voice belonged to, but I was too sleepy to open my eyes.
hunks.sol: Strangely, hearing that voice alone made me want to punch its owner. Part of me wanted to see who the familiar voice belonged to, but I was too sleepy to open my eyes.

hunks.baseline: “Why is the squad leader suddenly like this now of all times…”
hunks.sol: “Why did the Squad Leader have to become like this now, of all times…?”

hunks.baseline: It felt like listening to a broken radio. The voices had static in them, and they kept cutting out.
hunks.sol: It felt like listening to a broken radio. The voices were full of static and kept cutting out.

hunks.baseline: [^2]: A pun: the Korean word for a goshiwon manager sounds like “prime minister.”
